subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenWell (clarifying questions & next steps)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@zenwellhealth.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenWell (clarifying questions & next steps)

Hi Alex / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security/compliance review:

Summary from call:
- You're evaluating Redwood for patient-facing workflows (PHI) and want to confirm HIPAA coverage, SOC 2 posture, and vendor questionnaire cadence.
- Primary asks: SOC 2 status, data residency options, encryption controls, SIEM/alerting integration, and timing to complete a SIG (formerly CAIQ) questionnaire.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'm attaching the SIG questionnaire stub — could you confirm the best contact at ZenWell to receive the questionnaire (if not you two)?
2) Please flag any must-have Qs up front (e.g., EU residency, BAA required).
3) We'll populate the SIG and return initial responses within 3 business days; our security lead (Logan) will review any technical follow-ups.

A few quick answers (to unblock you):
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I; Type II audit currently in progress with expected completion Q3 2027.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows via our Private offering and can execute a BAA for hosted customers with additional controls.
- Encryption: Data-in-transit: TLS 1.2+; At-rest: AES-256.

Attachment: zenwell_SIG_20270508.pdf (SIG questionnaire stub; we'll fill and return)

Would you like an internal walkthrough on the SIG after we populate the first pass? Happy to lock a 30-min slot next week.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com
[Attachment: zenwell_SIG_20270508.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwellhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>, Alex Morgan <alex@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenWell (clarifying questions & next steps)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the fast follow-up and the stub. A couple of clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams before we start the SIG:

1) Can you confirm SOC 2 status in writing and whether there's a report we can review (Type I is noted — can you share coverage scope)?
2) Data residency: are we restricted to US-only hosted regions, or do you offer EU regions for data-at-rest?
3) HIPAA / BAA: if we go hosted (not Private), is there a standard BAA you execute and what controls are required on our side?
4) SIEM / logging: do you support push integrations to Splunk/Datadog or do we pull logs from an S3 bucket?
5) Any major third-party subprocessors (e.g., tracing, analytics) we should be aware of?

If you can answer 1-2 high-level items now (or point us at a doc), we can decide which sections of the SIG to prioritize. Target from procurement is to have a completed first pass in 10 business days if feasible.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Security Operations | ZenWell Health
elena.rossi@zenwellhealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwellhealth.com>, Alex Morgan <alex@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenWell (clarifying questions & next steps)

Elena —

Great questions; appreciate the clarity. I've attached the SIG stub we discussed and added a few initial high-level responses to speed things up. See below quick answers and links — I'll ask Logan to add any technical detail required.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type I report (coverage: control environment, change management, logical access). Type II audit in progress; expected completion Q3 2027. I've attached Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf which includes a short SOC scope summary and contact for audit requests.
- Data residency: Hosted regions currently include multiple US regions. For EU residency we can offer Private deployments or discuss enterprise arrangements (customer-managed VPC or on-prem package).
- HIPAA / BAA: We do execute BAAs for covered customers. Hosted customers are required to follow our recommended access controls and data handling checklist; Private deployments give more flexibility.
- SIEM / logging: We support push-based integrations (Splunk, Datadog) via secure syslog or API, and we also provide log export to S3 for customer retrieval.
- Subprocessors: Primary cloud provider (AWS), a logging/metrics provider, and a monitoring vendor. Full subprocessor list available in the security packet (link below).

Attachment: zenwell_SIG_20270508.pdf (filled stub — initial answers in sections 1-4), Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf
Security docs: https://redwood-inference.com/security/whitepaper.pdf
Shared workspace: https://drive.google.com/zenwell-sig

Can you confirm: who should own the returned SIG from ZenWell side, and is 10 business days still your target for a first pass? If yes, I'll mark the expected delivery for 2027-05-18 and coordinate internal review with Logan/Marissa.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Logan to go through any technical SIG items after you review the first pass.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com
[Attachments: zenwell_SIG_20270508.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood-inference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenwellhealth.com>, Alex Morgan <alex@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenWell (clarifying questions & next steps)

Hi all — looping in a few technical clarifications from our side to help you prioritize SIG sections. I reviewed Camila's initial answers and attached the security packet for reference. Short answers below:

- SOC 2: Confirmed — Type I report available now (I can share via secure link once NDA/portal access is set). Type II audit expected Q3 2027; audit scope includes our hosted API and console. If ZenWell requires audit evidence earlier, we can provide SOC 2 interim attestations and control descriptions.
- Data residency: Hosted product runs in US regions. For EU residency we recommend Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem). We can support customer-managed encryption keys (KMS) for Private deployments.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ for transit; AES-256 for encryption at rest. Key management options: Redwood KMS integration or bring-your-own-KMS for Private.
- SIEM/logging: We support push integrations to Splunk/Datadog, and structured logging exports to S3. We also have an events API for alerting.
- Subprocessors: AWS (compute/storage), Datadog (metrics/monitoring), Sentry (optional error monitoring). Full list in the attached packet.

Suggested SIG prioritization for ZenWell:
1) Sections covering access control, encryption, logging — high priority for PHI/HIPAA reviews.
2) Data residency & key management questions — mark as conditional (Private offering will satisfy EU residency).
3) Incident response / breach notification timelines — we have standard timelines in the packet and can add specific SLA language if required.

I can join a walkthrough after you finish the first pass; recommend scheduling a 30-min session where we go through any items you mark as "technical follow-up."

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood-inference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (application/pdf)]

Marissa — I'll defer to you on the internal timeline; happy to do the review same-day once Camila drops the first-pass answers.
